title: PVL: Galeries Tower suppresses Akari charge for breakthrough Siklab win
summary: Galeries Tower earned its first win of the 2026 Premier Volleyball League (PVL) All-Filipino Conference Siklab series through the hard way, suppressing a gritty charge from Akari in five frames,…

blocks.text: Galeries Tower earned its first win of the 2026 Premier Volleyball League (PVL) All-Filipino Conference Siklab series through the hard way, suppressing a gritty charge from Akari in five frames, 25-22, 26-24, 23-25, 15-25, 15-10, on Tuesday at the Araneta Coliseum in Quezon City.
